cve_summary: Use-after-free vulnerability in Google Chrome before 26.0.1410.43 on Linux allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service or possibly have unspecified other impact by leveraging the presence of an extension that creates a pop-up window.
docstring:
Summary: This code fragment handles different notification types using a switch statement and triggers an error for unexpected types.

Parameters: N/A

Returns: N/A

Logic: The switch statement evaluates the variable `type` against several predefined notification constants. If `type` matches any of the specified cases, the code simply breaks out of the switch without performing any action. If `type` does not match any of the cases, the default clause is executed, which calls the `FAIL()` macro to log an error message indicating that an unexpected notification type was encountered. This structure ensures that only recognized notification types are processed, while any unrecognized types result in an error, aiding in debugging and maintaining code integrity.
